text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Left: each product's mean absolute error minus ERA5's. Each label gives the product's own error, as a percentage of capacity. Right: the four contrasts named before the run. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026. Intervals on the left are against ERA5. Overlapping intervals do not mean two products are indistinguishable; the right-hand panel compares them directly.'
text.tspan: Left: each product's mean absolute error minus ERA5's. Each label gives the product's own error, as a percentage of capacity.
Right: the four contrasts named before the run. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output.
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. 6 solar farms in Lincolnshire, December 2022 to September 2026.
Intervals on the left are against ERA5. Overlapping intervals do not mean two products are indistinguishable; the right-hand panel compares them directly.
